We ran the multi-group ctwas with parameters: L=5, shared_all, thin=1


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(ctwas)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

gwas_n <- 487511
outputdir <- "/project/xinhe/xsun/AD_jubao/3.ctwas/output"
qtl_types <- c("caQTL", "eQTL")
```

# caQTL

```{r caQTL-load}
param_caQTL <- readRDS(file.path(outputdir, "caQTL", "AD.caQTL.param.shared_all.RDS"))
```

## Convergence

```{r caQTL-convergence, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
make_convergence_plots(param_caQTL, gwas_n)
```

## Parameters and Enrichment

```{r caQTL-param}
ctwas_param_caQTL <- summarize_param(param_caQTL, gwas_n, enrichment_test = "fisher")
ctwas_param_caQTL
```

## Heritability Pie Chart

```{r caQTL-piechart, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
pve_caQTL <- data.frame(
  category = names(ctwas_param_caQTL$prop_heritability),
  percentage = ctwas_param_caQTL$prop_heritability
)
pve_caQTL$label <- paste0(round(pve_caQTL$percentage * 100, 1), "%")

ggplot(pve_caQTL, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  theme_void() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4) +
  labs(fill = "Group", title = "caQTL-Percent of Heritability (PVE)")
```
